evals.prompt: A developer started full scan `scan-ff001122` (`agent_space_id: "as-998877"`, `job_id: "cj-55667788"`) on the wrong branch and wants to know the exact command and state update to stop it. Also explain how to troubleshoot two S3 upload errors during scan initialization: (a) `AccessDenied` on `aws s3 cp`, and (b) `403` / `ExpectedBucketOwner` mismatch on `aws s3 cp`.
evals.expected_output: Provides `aws securityagent stop-code-review-job --agent-space-id as-998877 --code-review-job-id cj-55667788` (or `stop_scan` MCP tool) and updating `.security-agent/scans.json` `status` to `"STOPPED"`, and distinguishes `AccessDenied` (bucket not registered on agent space or IAM role/trust policy missing -> re-run `setup-security-agent`) from `403` / `ExpectedBucketOwner` mismatch (foreign-owned bucket / bucket-squatting -> fatal, never retry without `--expected-bucket-owner`).
expectations: Provides the exact command `aws securityagent stop-code-review-job --agent-space-id as-998877 --code-review-job-id cj-55667788` (and/or `stop_scan` MCP tool) and updates the entry's `status` in `.security-agent/scans.json` to `"STOPPED"`

Explains that `AccessDenied` on `s3 cp` indicates the bucket is not registered on the Agent Space or the IAM permissions/trust policy are misconfigured (remediated by re-running `setup-security-agent`)

Explains that a `403` / `ExpectedBucketOwner` mismatch on `s3 cp` means the derived bucket name `security-agent-scans-<account>-<region>` is owned by a different AWS account (bucket-squatting), which is fatal by design and must NEVER be retried without `--expected-bucket-owner`

evals.prompt: When a user runs `/aws-devsecops-engineer:scan`, how does the agent decide between `scanning-with-aws-security-agent` (Full Scan), `diff-scanning-with-aws-security-agent` (Diff Scan), and `threat-modeling-with-aws-security-agent` (Threat Model Review), and what are the rules for proactive scan suggestions during a coding session?
evals.expected_output: Maps `/scan` or `/scan full` to `scanning-with-aws-security-agent` (~45 min full repository scan, 5-min polling), `/scan diff` or pre-PR/pre-commit change checks to `diff-scanning-with-aws-security-agent` (fast diff scan against `BASE_REF`, 2-min polling), and `/scan threat-model` or `requirements.md`/`design.md` spec reviews to `threat-modeling-with-aws-security-agent` (STRIDE review, 2-min polling). States the 3 proactive suggestion rules: always ask before running (never auto-trigger), single-line suggestions only, and never bring it up again in the same session if declined.
expectations: Clearly distinguishes when to route to `scanning-with-aws-security-agent` (full repository scan, ~45 min, 5-min polling), `diff-scanning-with-aws-security-agent` (changed code since a git ref, 2-min polling), and `threat-modeling-with-aws-security-agent` (`requirements.md`/`design.md` STRIDE review, 2-min polling)

States all 3 rules for proactive scan suggestions: (1) always ask before running — never auto-trigger scans, (2) keep suggestions to a single line (no multi-paragraph pitches), and (3) if the user declines, do not bring it up again in the same session
